scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:push -w server && npm run db:seed -w server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,admin -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w admin"
scripts.build: npm run build -w admin && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w admin
